items.note: The plan states the three-stage map (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, and derives it as the paper does: the eight-row net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, the bit coefficient |S∩T| mod 2 cancelled by the side wires, then the stage composition (lines 741-764). Only the bit construction is treated: the complex coefficient check (|S∩T|-1)/2 (lines 756-758), which the complex network in S2.4 relies on, is missing, as are h=100, the neighbour counts and the wire counts W_b, W_c.

It states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, and derives it by the paper's invariant: logical input D_in^{-1}f, edges carry D_u phi to D_v phi, and a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate (lines 804-818).

It covers the form I-J/9 on Q^h, the matching stage transitions, the side-wire inclusion through t_X ⊥ t_Y, the single decrease at center 3->4 of dimension h, the gate telescoping to Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich and L_b/N=100/539 (L_c/N=101/539 appears in S2.4.1.2). All of this matches lines 856-1071 and 1105-1109. The binary orthonormal-basis part of the lemma (lines 1073-1102) is only used, never derived, but it is not essential to the bit chain.

The assignment of P_U to gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} to sources, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N rank-one exceptions 2P_{U_a}, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b, and the endpoint identity P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m all follow the proof at lines 1156-1171.

The phase frames, one kernel (aI+bX_v)^{±1} per orthonormal residual vector through mod-4 weight additivity, and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m all match lines 1214-1260. The endpoint computation is missing: zero label gives frame I, full label gives C^{⊗m}, and the X_a->Y_a route carries C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates, fixed by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k} (lines 1287-1314). The plan reduces this essential step to 'after the source and sink sign corrections'.

For the bit network it gives s_b<W_b m from L_b<N/2, eta_b=339/22587335000000>20·2^{-50}, log m<20, and the chain m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-eta), as at lines 1331-1341. For the complex network it gives s_c<W_c m, but eta_c and the value sigma=1-2^{-50} are never stated; S2.4.5 uses sigma without a value.

S2.1 states the linear-cost digit permutations, digit moves, split/merge and cyclic row split. S2.2 states the controlled shift and the unit multiplication, with a one-line mechanism for the shift. The hypotheses are missing: the offset must be preparable in b^{O(1)} time, and the denominators and numerators must be prime to q (lines 557-566). No derivation of S2.1 is given.

The steps follow the paper: the factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 by pivoting on the rightmost entry of the topmost nonzero row, lower-triangular updates in descending order as controlled shifts with q avoiding denominators, and each one of Π done as D+=H, swap, D=H-D, giving exactly a interchanges (lines 1375-1446).

Every step of the proof at lines 1491-1615 is reconstructed: the cyclic row split into W streams, shear frames Φ_M giving H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows, the three-update interchange, exactly s calls on volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum in both cases a<=1 and a>1, and the parking-stack schedule.

The steps match lines 1650-1734: the top rho=O(log e) digits form a row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k padded to a multiple of W^k, the base-m pieces sum to O(Ve^tau), and the binary chunks are padded to [q^e]. The unequal-width extension (lines 1740-1762) is omitted, but it is not part of the lemma itself.

errors.says: <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1, 'with the self pairing <t_T,t_T>=2 as the exception'.
errors.paper: The self pairing 2 is the same formula at S=T, since |T∩T|-1=2. It is listed alongside the general formula, not as an exception to it.

errors.says: Both the controlled update and multiplication by a fixed rational unit cost O(V) 'by splitting each fiber at Q-a and merging the two pieces in the opposite order'.
errors.paper: Only the shift uses the split at Q-a. Multiplication by c uses c increasing pieces classified by ⌊cy/Q⌋, with a residue-counter merge and a separate negation procedure. The plan also omits the hypothesis that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route. It builds the bit and complex networks, the frame principle, the label budget giving s<Wm, the shear and phase interfaces, the two recurrences giving O(Vu^tau) and O(Vd^{lambda'}), and the synthetic transforms. These feed the resampling, chirp, CRT and twist reduction, then exact recovery, and finally the margin table with min g_2=2kappa. It thins out in three places: the complex network is never derived (no complex coefficient check), the complex interface's endpoint corrections are only asserted, and the guard-width count behind the single truncation is not derived.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), the restoration of every scratch wire and the role of three-element subsets are all reconstructed. The defining constants h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear, although m and N are used. Graded conservatively.

It has frames D_v, edges D_vD_u^{-1}, a common frame commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and endpoint frames that fix routes while intermediate frames make edges cheap.
It has nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} with F=Q^h, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges at the center 3->4, each losing h.
It shows that rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels, and that the N source edges 2P_{U_a} are rank-one exceptions.
It has the sum of |Δdim| equal to Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=(W_b m-2N+2L_b)+N=W_b m-N+2L_b.
It gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 make s<Wm.
It has the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, giving the shear H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A=E_1ΠE_2 gives exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per edge, so there are exactly s recursive calls in all.
It has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta_b>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, hence F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving essentially in full, from frames, labels and rank equal to dimension change, through the budget, the strict deficit from L/N<1/2 and the endpoint identity, to edges as recursive calls and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The one gap is C1: the network's mechanism is carried, but its defining sizes h=100, N and m are never stated.
